_about: Shops (Shop, ShopMenu, ShopScreen; README.md, Shops). Per shop: name, map (its inside, data/maps), open [first hour, closing hour) and days_off (mon..sun): outside those the door and the counter only say closed_message (%s = the shop name, then the hours and the days off). keeper: the villager who stands at the counter ("" = nobody; the counter works without one); with a keeper the shop also sells only while their day plan has them on the shop's map, and talking to them at the map's keeper spot opens it. festival_away: what the counter says while the keeper is out on a festival day (%s = the festival's name; their day plan takes them to it). away: what it says while the keeper is out on an ordinary day (default "Nobody is at the counter"). stock: what it sells, per season plus "any" (every season) and "supplies" (every season, listed first), each {item, price?, name?, to?, full?}: without a price the item's own one is used (seed_price in crops.json for seeds:<crop>, price in foods.json for food:<id>). to says where a purchase goes: "rucksack" (default), "animal" (animal:<kind>, Game.add_animal, refused with full when its home has no room) "feed" (portions into the coop's feed sack) or "fodder" (bundles into the barn's loft); animal:<kind>:young is a calf / lamb (grows up in the barn). rucksack: bigger rucksacks for sale, each level {slots (the bag's new size), price}, bought once each in order. kitchen_tools: cooking tools for sale once the house extension needs is built, each bought once (names and prices in data/recipes.json tools; Game.kitchen_tools, saved), listed in the buy tab after the rucksack. builds: house extensions the builder (a villager) makes, per id {name, about, price, days, chest_slots?}; done is the morning message (%s = its name); away is what the builder's own counter says while they are out building (Game.BUILD_FLAG, from the morning after the order; their day plan puts them on the farm); plan is that day plan's name: a day of the job they spend on another plan (a storm keeps Hachiro at the forge, his birthday) doesn't count, the job is due a day later (Game house_job late), and the note says away_late (%s = its name, then the new due date) and the build tab late (%s = the due date); one at a time, paid when ordered, finished overnight on the ready day; the map changes come from the "extensions" of that map's file (data/maps/house.json). buys: what it buys from the farmer, kind -> percent of the item's value (crop = its sell price, dish = a food's sell in foods.json (the kitchen's dishes; not foods with shop true, which the stand sells), food = its price (other foods); stone, ore and gem = the kinds of mine finds, their sell in data/mine.json). upgrades: tools it improves, per target level {price, days, items?} (items: id -> how many, taken from the rucksack when the tool is handed in, e.g. ores from the mine) (tool_levels: other levels for one tool, e.g. the rod, whose levels are in data/fish.json); the tool is handed in, comes back that many days later (collect it while the shop is open). under_glass: once the farm job named in its needs is built (the greenhouse), the seeds of every other season the shop lists are sold too, at its percent of their price (Shop.stock, Game.shop_buy), marked under glass in the buy tab. Names, prices and hours are ours; see WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Shops.

builds._farm_jobs: A job with "farm" builds onto that farm building (data/animals.json homes.<home>.wing; the map's extensions) instead of the house: Game.FARM_FLAG holds its id while it is under way (Hachiro's building_farm plan, his lumber between the coop and the barn), and the record's House built leaves it out. Prices ours: the coop's about three and a half hens, the barn's two cows. "work_flag" is a flag also set while the job is under way (Hachiro's own plan for it: the silo's building_silo, his lumber beside the silo); the silo (farm "silo", data/animals.json silo) is no animal home: 3000 G, 3 days, about 120 bundles of fodder at the store's 25 G, which a silo of cut grass pays back over most of a year. The greenhouse (farm "greenhouse", data/maps/greenhouse.json, Game.greenhouse) is the dearest job and a late-game goal: 30000 G, 6 days, more than the second room; its 32 beds grow the dear fall crops through the winter (about 9000 G a winter, more in the other seasons beside the field), so it pays back in about two years. A day of any plan named "plan" plus an underscore and more (building_farm, building_silo, building_greenhouse) is a day of work too, so a farm job is done on time.

clinic._note: Dr. Yae's Hinata Clinic (data/maps/clinic.json): open every day, since people fall ill on Sundays too; it sells only the herb tonic, the one food that takes a big bite out of fatigue. 400 G is ours: more than amazake (stamina) and mugwort tea (half swing fatigue), so it is a remedy, not a snack; about the price of a collapse's fee plus a lost morning's work.
clinic.name: Hinata Clinic

teahouse._note: Fumi's Hanami Teahouse in Sakurazaka (data/maps/teahouse.json): open every day 9:00-18:00 like its door, but only while Fumi is in (she sweeps the gravel and walks to the bridge 13:00-15:00; her note says so; on a festival day she goes down to the village and her festival note says where). Tea and one sweet the year round, a sweet of the season, and whipped matcha, which only she makes: the strongest fatigue cure short of the clinic's tonic (-8 for 150 G, against mugwort tea's half swing fatigue at 350 and the tonic's -15 at 400). The seasonal sweets sit between dango and amazake for stamina per G; they are a treat on the way to the mine, not a cheaper store. Names and prices are ours.
